svg.title: F151.4 the framework's components: the agent shows a card, in the new look

g.text: F151.4 the framework's components: the agent shows a card, in the new look
a ring in --web-agent, the rest dimmed
the words, where the card beside stands

text.tspan: The states a card can be in are the widget's to draw:
a visitor's mark in their colour, the agent's in violet, and the agent's
words in the place of the card beside.
